definition_zh: 每个人；人人；大家
definition_en: every person; all people
core_image: 热闹的操场：上课铃一响，所有人都跑回教室
scene: 大扫除一开始，教室里人人都动了起来。Everybody helped to clean the classroom after school.
sceneCN: 这里 everybody 是「每个人」（第 1 个义项：所有人无一例外）；句意是放学后大家都帮忙打扫教室。

derivatives.zh: 同义代词，语体稍正式
由 every 加 thing 构成，指物，义为「一切」

senses.title: Every person, all people
senses.definition: every single person in a group, followed by a singular verb
senses.definitionCN: 一群中的每一个人，后接单数动词
senses.example: Everybody was happy with the picnic plan.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人对野餐计划都很满意。

senses.whyCN: 该词由 every 与 body（古义指人）结合，先逐个点名再合为一体。

senses.title: People in general
senses.definition: people in general, often in friendly spoken phrases
senses.definitionCN: 泛指一般人，常见于亲切的口语表达
senses.example: Everybody loves a sunny holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 人人都爱阳光灿烂的假期。
senses.why: When the group is left unnamed, the roll call stretches out to cover all people.
senses.whyCN: 当群体未指明时，点名册扩展覆盖所有人。

intro.en: Everybody fuses every with body, which in older English could simply mean a person. It has kept its friendly, spoken tone ever since.
intro.cn: everybody 由 every 与 body 融合，body 在古英语可单指「人」。该词一直保留亲切的口语色彩。

items.en: Old English bodig meant the physical body, but body could also stand for a person.
items.cn: 古英语 bodig 指身体，但 body 也可指代一个人。

items.en: The compound everybody formed beside everyone in the fourteenth century.
items.cn: 十四世纪复合词 everybody 与 everyone 并肩形成。

items.en: It took the friendly spoken role, while everyone leaned more formal.
items.cn: 它承担口语亲切角色，everyone 则偏正式。

items.en: Grammar settled the singular verb: everybody is, not everybody are.
items.cn: 语法确定单数动词：everybody is 而非 everybody are。

items.en: The singular their, as in everybody brought their lunch, is now widely accepted.
items.cn: 单数配复数 their（如 everybody brought their lunch）如今已被广泛接受。

note.en: The first group collects the every-compound family; the second collects near meanings about people.
note.cn: 第一组收集 every 复合词族；第二组收集与「人」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: the same meaning with a slightly formal tone
entries.definitionCN: 每个人。意义相同，语气稍正式。

entries.definition: all the other people besides the one mentioned
entries.definitionCN: 其他所有人。加 else 排除所提之人。

entries.definition: some person unknown, used in positive sentences
entries.definitionCN: 某人。用于肯定句，指不确定的某人。

entries.definition: a close synonym, interchangeable in most sentences
entries.definitionCN: 每个人。最接近的同义词，多数句子可互换。

entries.definition: the whole group, takes plural verbs
entries.definitionCN: 全部；所有人。接复数动词。

entries.definition: any person at all, often in questions and negatives
entries.definitionCN: 任何人。常用于疑问句与否定句。

normalIntro.en: Five concrete hooks built from the body root and school scenes.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于 body 词根与校园场景的具体联想。

normal.en: Everybody plus body: each body, each person, is present.
normal.cn: everybody＝every＋body：每个「body（人）」都在场。

normal.en: Everybody is here takes the singular verb is, not are.
normal.cn: Everybody is here 用单数动词 is，语法别丢。

normal.en: Everybody sounds friendlier than everyone in chat.
normal.cn: everybody 比 everyone 更口语，聊天时更常用。

normal.en: Everybody knows is a high-frequency line in songs and talk.
normal.cn: Everybody knows 是歌词和口语里的高频句。

normal.en: The sound hints at wanting to hug each person, for spelling only.
normal.cn: 谐音：「爱夫瑞抱低」——想抱一抱每个人，帮助拼读，不是词源。

abstract.en: Picture the whole playground emptying into classrooms at the bell.
abstract.cn: 画面：铃响时整个操场的人都跑回教室。

abstract.en: See every hand go up at the same time.
abstract.cn: 动作：全班的手同时举起。

abstract.en: Feel one big circle of arms around the whole group.
abstract.cn: 感觉：一个大圈的手臂围住全组。

examples.en: Everybody was excited about the sports day.
examples.cn: 大家都为运动会感到兴奋。

examples.en: Come on, everybody, it is time to go home.
examples.cn: 来吧大家，该回家了。

examples.en: Almost everybody in our class likes this song.
examples.cn: 我们班几乎每个人都喜欢这首歌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱夫瑞抱低」——想抱一抱每个人，谐音帮助拼读，不是词源。

root: everybody 由 every（ever 与 each 的融合词）加 body（古义可指「人」）构成，与 everyone 同义；语法上作单数。

sensesIntro.en: Everybody counts every person one by one, then gathers them into one friendly, spoken whole.
sensesIntro.cn: everybody 先逐人清点，再以亲切的口吻合为全体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the whole playground pouring back into classrooms at the bell.
core.cn: 核心意象：铃响时整个操场的人都涌回教室。

branches.cn: 每个人对野餐计划都满意。
泛指众人：人人都爱假期。
单数语法配口语口吻。
全组共同的情感。
词语底下的「一群人」画面。

intro.en: Everybody compounds every with body; its siblings are everyone, everything and everywhere.
intro.cn: everybody 由 every 复合 body；同辈为 everyone、everything 与 everywhere。

items.example: Every supplies the no-exception idea.
items.exampleCN: every 提供无一例外之意。

items.example: Body once stood for a person in law phrases.
items.exampleCN: body 曾在法律短语中指人。

items.example: Everyone and everybody are twins.
items.exampleCN: everyone 与 everybody 是双胞胎。

items.example: Somebody left a note on the desk.
items.exampleCN: 有人在桌上留了张便条。

items.example: Anybody can join the club.

definition_zh: 日常的；每天的；平常的
definition_en: ordinary and happening every day; not special
core_image: 每天背的那只旧书包：普通却可靠
scene: 巷口早餐铺每天清晨升起同样的白汽。Carrying an old school bag is part of his everyday routine.
sceneCN: 这里 everyday 是「日常的」（第 1 个义项：普通且每天发生）；句意是背旧书包是他日常习惯的一部分。

derivatives.zh: 拆开的短语形式，义为「每天」，作时间状语
较罕见派生词，义为「日常性；平淡」
相关词，义为「例行公事」，常与 everyday 搭配

senses.title: Ordinary and daily
senses.definition: happening or used every day, ordinary and not special
senses.definitionCN: 每天发生或使用，普通而不特别
senses.example: She wore her everyday clothes to the market.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿着便服去市场。
senses.why: Every plus day fuses into one adjective: the day that happens again and again.
senses.whyCN: every 与 day 融合成一个形容词：日复一日的那一天。

senses.title: Commonplace, not remarkable
senses.definition: very ordinary, without anything special about it
senses.definitionCN: 十分普通，毫无特别之处
senses.example: The magician turned everyday objects into surprises.
senses.exampleCN: 魔术师把寻常物品变成惊喜。
senses.why: Repetition dulls wonder, so the word also means unremarkable.
senses.whyCN: 重复使惊奇变钝，于是词义也指平凡无奇。

intro.en: Everyday is the closed-up form of the phrase every day. When the phrase became an adjective, the space closed and the stress moved to the first part.
intro.cn: everyday 是短语 every day 的合写形式。短语转为形容词后，空格闭合，重音移到前部。

items.en: Every was already fused from ever and each in the thirteenth century.
items.cn: every 在十三世纪已由 ever 与 each 融合而成。

items.en: The phrase every day appeared in Middle English as a plain time expression.
items.cn: 短语 every day 在中古英语中作为朴素时间表达出现。

items.en: Writers began closing the phrase to everyday when using it before nouns as an adjective.
items.cn: 作家在名词前作形容词使用时开始将短语合写为 everyday。

items.en: Dictionaries recorded the closed form in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 词典在十八世纪收录合写形式。

items.en: Modern style guides now teach the split: everyday clothes but I read every day.
items.cn: 现代文体指南区分：everyday clothes 与 I read every day。

note.en: The first group collects the everyday family; the second collects near meanings about ordinariness.
note.cn: 第一组收集 everyday 词族的成员；第二组收集与「平凡」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: two words, an adverbial of time meaning each day
entries.definitionCN: 每天（两词短语）。作时间状语，不是形容词。

entries.definition: the quality of being ordinary
entries.definitionCN: 日常性；平淡。由 everyday 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: a day on which one works, or the hours of a working day
entries.definitionCN: 工作日；工作时长。复合词，结构相似。

entries.definition: normal, not different or special
entries.definitionCN: 普通的。强调与他人无异。

entries.definition: happening once a day, often about routines
entries.definitionCN: 每日的。侧重频率一天一次。

entries.definition: seen everywhere, therefore dull
entries.definitionCN: 平凡的；司空见惯的。书面语，略带贬义。

normal.en: Closed everyday is the adjective; open every day means each day.
normal.cn: 合写 everyday 是形容词；分开 every day 是「每天」状语。

normal.en: Everyday life is the most common phrase of the family.
normal.cn: everyday life 日常生活，最常用搭配。

normal.en: Everyday clothes are the opposite of Sunday best.

examples.en: Riding the bus is part of my everyday life.

examples.en: These everyday objects can all become science tools.

items.en: The roots aefre (ever) and aelc (each) waited in Old English before the fusion.
items.cn: 古英语中 aefre（ever）与 aelc（each）在融合之前已并存。

items.en: The fused every appeared in the thirteenth century, ready to join with one.
items.cn: 十三世纪融合词 every 出现，为与 one 结合做好准备。

items.en: Everyone was formed as a pronoun, sharing work with the older everybody.
items.cn: everyone 构成代词，与更早的 everybody 分担功能。

items.en: Grammar books settled the singular verb: everyone is, not everyone are.
items.cn: 语法书确定单数动词：everyone is 而非 everyone are。

items.en: The plural their, as in everyone brought their book, is now widely accepted.
items.cn: 复数 their（如 everyone brought their book）如今已被广泛接受。

note.en: The first group collects the every-compound family; the second collects near meanings about people as a whole.
note.cn: 第一组收集 every 复合词族；第二组收集与「全体的人」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: the same meaning, a friendlier spoken tone
entries.definitionCN: 人人。意义相同，语气更口语亲切。

entries.definition: every thing, not every person; objects and facts
entries.definitionCN: 每件事；一切。指物不指人。

entries.definition: in every place, an adverb of location
entries.definitionCN: 到处。地点副词，与人物无关。

entries.definition: the whole group, takes plural verbs
entries.definitionCN: 全部；所有人。整体视角，接复数动词。

entries.definition: one by one, a more careful counting view
entries.definitionCN: 每个人（逐个）。强调逐个视角。

entries.definition: any person at all, often in questions and negatives
entries.definitionCN: 任何人。常用于疑问句与否定句。

normalIntro.en: Five concrete hooks built from grammar facts and classroom speech.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于语法事实与课堂用语的具体联想。

normal.en: Every plus one builds the word, and no one is left out.
normal.cn: everyone＝every＋one，每个「one」都不落下。

normal.en: Everyone is here takes a singular verb, is not are.
normal.cn: Everyone is here. 后接单数动词 is，语法记牢。

normal.en: Everyone is a little more formal than everybody.
normal.cn: everyone 与 everybody 同义，前者稍正式。

normal.en: Say hello to everyone opens many a class naturally.
normal.cn: Say hello to everyone 课前向全班问好，场景自然。

normal.en: The sound hints at loving every one of ten thousand, for spelling only.
normal.cn: 谐音：「爱夫瑞万」——爱每一个人，帮助拼读，不是词源。

abstract.en: Picture a class photo where not a single face is missing.
abstract.cn: 画面：全班合影，一张脸都不缺。

abstract.en: Hear one round of applause rising from the whole hall.
abstract.cn: 听觉：全场响起一片掌声。

abstract.en: Feel a warm hand touching every shoulder in a line.
abstract.cn: 动作：一只温暖的手依次拍过一排肩膀。

examples.en: Everyone was excited about the school trip.
examples.cn: 大家对学校郊游都很兴奋。

examples.en: Good luck to everyone taking the exam today.
examples.cn: 祝今天参加考试的每个人好运。

examples.en: Everyone knows that practice makes perfect.
examples.cn: 大家都知道熟能生巧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱夫瑞万」——爱每一个人，谐音帮助拼读，不是词源。

root: everyone 由 every（ever 与 each 的融合词）加 one 构成，属 every 复合代词家族；与 everybody 同义，语法上作单数。

sensesIntro.en: Everyone counts a group person by person, then speaks of them all with one singular voice.
sensesIntro.cn: everyone 先逐人清点，再以单数的口吻指代全体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a class photo with no missing face.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张脸都不缺的全班合影。

branches.cn: 班里每个人都通过了考试。
泛指众人：大家都知道。
多人却用单数语法。
属于全体的共同认知。
词语底下的点名单画面。

intro.en: Everyone is itself a compound; its siblings are everybody, everything and everywhere.
intro.cn: everyone 是复合词；同辈为 everybody、everything 与 everywhere。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root applies; the family is Germanic, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 本词与拉丁词根无关，词族属于日耳曼语，因此拉丁同源词列表为空。

items.example: Every supplies the no-exception idea.
items.exampleCN: every 提供无一例外之意。

items.example: One makes the word refer to people.
Everybody came to the party.
Everything is ready for the trip.
items.exampleCN: 旅行的一切都准备好了。

items.example: Spring flowers grow everywhere here.
All of us agreed quickly.
Does anybody have a question?
None of the answers was right.

definition_zh: 每件事；一切；所有事物；最重要的事
definition_en: all things; every single thing
core_image: 一张写满的清单：每一行都打了勾
scene: 露营前一晚，妈妈把装备一件件摆上桌。We packed everything we needed for the camping trip.
sceneCN: 这里 everything 是「一切」（第 1 个义项：所有事物）；句意是我们打包了露营所需的一切。

derivatives.zh: 同族代词，指人，义为「每个人」
同族副词，指地点，义为「到处」
基础词，义为「事物；东西」

senses.title: All things
senses.definition: every single thing in a group or situation, followed by a singular verb
senses.definitionCN: 某个群体或情境中的每一件事，后接单数动词
senses.example: Everything in the room was covered with dust.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里的每样东西都蒙着灰。
senses.why: The word walks a full checklist, then seals it into one single bundle.
senses.whyCN: 这个词走完整张清单，再把它们封成一束。

senses.title: The most important thing
senses.definition: the thing that matters most, often in mean everything to someone
senses.definitionCN: 最重要的事，常见于 mean everything to someone
senses.example: Her little brother means everything to her.
senses.exampleCN: 弟弟对她来说就是一切。
senses.why: When one item outweighs the whole list, everything shrinks to that single treasure.
senses.whyCN: 当一件事重过整张清单，everything 便缩为那唯一的珍宝。

intro.en: Everything joins every with the Old English word thing, which once meant an assembly and then any matter discussed there.
intro.cn: everything 由 every 与古英语 thing 结合，thing 原指集会，后指会上讨论的任何事务。

items.en: Old English thing meant a meeting or assembly, where matters were settled.
items.cn: 古英语 thing 指集会，人们在会上处理事务。

items.en: The word then narrowed to any matter or object discussed or dealt with.
items.cn: 词义随后收窄为任何被讨论、处理的事物。

items.en: Middle English thing was ready to compound, and every supplied the total sweep.
items.cn: 中古英语 thing 可参与复合，every 提供全覆盖的扫掠。

items.en: Everything appeared as a pronoun beside everyone and everybody.
items.cn: everything 作为代词与 everyone、everybody 并列出现。

items.en: The emotional use, meaning everything to someone, grew in everyday speech.
items.cn: 「对某人意义重于一切」的情感用法在口语中生长。

note.en: The first group collects the every-compound family; the second collects near meanings about totality.
note.cn: 第一组收集 every 复合词族；第二组收集与「全部」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: every person; people, not things
entries.definitionCN: 每个人。指人不指物。

entries.definition: any thing at all, used in questions and negatives
entries.definitionCN: 任何事物。用于疑问句与否定句。

entries.definition: no thing at all; the direct opposite
entries.definitionCN: 什么都没有。直接反义词。

entries.definition: the whole amount, works for people and things
entries.definitionCN: 全部。可用于人与物，接复数动词。

entries.definition: informal British phrase for everything
entries.definitionCN: 全部（口语）。英式口语表达。

entries.definition: everything mentioned, a pointing phrase
entries.definitionCN: 所有提到的那些。指代前文内容。

normalIntro.en: Five concrete hooks built from the thing root and packing scenes.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于 thing 词根与打包场景的具体联想。

normal.en: Every plus thing builds the word, counting each single item.
normal.cn: everything＝every＋thing，每一件「thing」都算。

normal.en: Thing once meant an assembly matter, so it covers things and events.
normal.cn: thing 古义是集会上议的事，所以指物也指事。

normal.en: Everything is ready is the calmest line before a trip.
normal.cn: Everything is ready 出发前最安心的一句话。

normal.en: Compare everything, anything and nothing as a triangle.
normal.cn: 对比三角：everything、anything、nothing 一正一疑一反。

normal.en: The sound hints at gathering every star on a list, for spelling only.
normal.cn: 谐音：「爱夫瑞星」——把每颗星都收进清单，帮助拼读，不是词源。

abstract.en: Picture a packed suitcase with every item ticked off.
abstract.cn: 画面：行李箱装满，清单上每项都打勾。

abstract.en: Sweep the desk clean into one neat drawer.
abstract.cn: 动作：把桌面一扫收进一个整齐抽屉。

abstract.en: Feel a warm weight, like carrying the whole of home.
abstract.cn: 感觉：怀抱如家一般全部的温暖重量。

examples.en: Everything on the menu looks delicious.
examples.cn: 菜单上的每样东西看起来都很好吃。

examples.en: Don't worry; everything will be fine.
examples.cn: 别担心，一切都会好起来的。

examples.en: Our dog means everything to our family.
examples.cn: 我们的狗对全家来说就是一切。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱夫瑞星」——把每颗星都收进清单，谐音帮助拼读，不是词源。

root: everything 由 every 加 thing 构成；thing 源自古英语，原指集会，后指事务与物件。本词与 everyone、everywhere 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Everything seals all things into one bundle, and can even shrink to the single thing that matters most.
sensesIntro.cn: everything 先把万物封作一束，也能缩为最重要的一件事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a full checklist with every line ticked.
core.cn: 核心意象：每一行都打勾的完整清单。

branches.cn: 房间里的每样东西都蒙着灰。
弟弟对她来说就是一切。
万事封作一个词。
覆盖一生的爱与价值。
出发前一切就绪。

intro.en: Everything compounds every with thing; its siblings point to people and places.
intro.cn: everything 由 every 复合 thing；同辈词分别指向人与地点。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root applies; the family is Germanic, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 本词与拉丁词根无关，词族属于日耳曼语，因此拉丁同源词列表为空。

items.example: Every sweeps the whole set.

items.meaning: an object or matter, once an assembly
items.example: Old English thing meant a meeting.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 thing 指集会。

items.example: Everyone and everything mirror each other.
items.exampleCN: everyone 与 everything 相互对应。

items.example: Ask me anything you like.
Nothing happened that night.
There is something in my shoe.
Pack the tent first, then everything else.
items.exampleCN: 先装帐篷，再装其他一切。

items.example: What is that thing on the table?

definition_zh: 到处；处处；无论何处
definition_en: in or to every place
core_image: 蒲公英种子随风散落：每一处都落一颗
scene: 春雨过后，操场砖缝里一夜冒出绿芽。After the rain, green shoots appeared everywhere on the playground.
sceneCN: 这里 everywhere 是「到处」（第 1 个义项：在每个地方）；句意是雨后操场到处冒出绿芽。

derivatives.zh: 同族代词，指人，义为「每个人」
同族代词，指物，义为「一切」
同结构词，义为「在某处」

senses.title: In every place
senses.definition: in all places, or in most places around here
senses.definitionCN: 在所有地方，或在这一带大多数地方
senses.example: Toys were scattered everywhere in the nursery.
senses.exampleCN: 育婴室里到处散落着玩具。
senses.why: Every plus where sweeps a map, dropping one dot on each square.
senses.whyCN: every 加 where 扫过一张地图，在每个格子里落一个点。

senses.title: To every place one goes
senses.definition: to all the places that someone goes, often introducing a clause
senses.definitionCN: 到某人去的所有地方，常引导从句
senses.example: Everywhere she travels, she keeps a small notebook.
senses.exampleCN: 无论她到哪里旅行，都随身带着小笔记本。
senses.why: The map follows the walker, so every step lands in a covered square.
senses.whyCN: 地图跟随行者，每一步都落在已覆盖的格子里。

senses.title: All places as a whole
senses.definition: every place considered together, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 所有地方合起来看，用作名词
senses.example: Everywhere looks beautiful in the first snow.
senses.exampleCN: 初雪中的处处景致都很美。
senses.why: Gather all the dots back into one sheet and the noun appears.
senses.whyCN: 把所有点收回一张纸，名词便出现。

intro.en: Everywhere fuses every with where, an Old English word for place or manner. It is the place-mate of everyone and everything.
intro.cn: everywhere 由 every 与古英语 where（处所）融合而成，是 everyone 与 everything 的「地点兄弟」。

items.en: Old English hwaer meant 'where', asking about place or manner.
items.cn: 古英语 hwaer 意为「在哪里」，询问处所或方式。

items.en: Middle English everywhere appeared beside everywhere-else phrases in texts.
items.cn: 中古英语 everywhere 与其他处所短语并见于文献。

items.en: The adverb settled into daily speech for total place coverage.
items.cn: 副词定型于日常口语，表示地点全覆盖。

items.en: The clause use, everywhere you go, became common in storytelling.
items.cn: 从句用法 everywhere you go 在叙事中变得常用。

items.en: The noun use, everywhere looks beautiful, is a later stylistic choice.
items.cn: 名词用法 everywhere looks beautiful 是后来的文体选择。

note.en: The first group collects the every-compound family; the second collects near meanings about place.
note.cn: 第一组收集 every 复合词族；第二组收集与「地点」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: to any place at all; the parts are swapped but the idea overlaps
entries.definitionCN: 无论哪里。语序相反而意义部分重叠。

entries.definition: in all other places, excluding here
entries.definitionCN: 其他所有地方。加 else 排除此处。

entries.definition: in any place, used in questions and negatives
entries.definitionCN: 任何地方。用于疑问句与否定句。

entries.definition: across the whole area, informal
entries.definitionCN: 到处；遍及。口语常用。

entries.definition: over a large area, a literary phrase
entries.definitionCN: 四面八方。文学化表达。

entries.definition: toward every side at once
entries.definitionCN: 向四面八方。强调方向的分散。

normalIntro.en: Five concrete hooks built from the where root and everyday scenes.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于 where 词根与日常场景的具体联想。

normal.en: Every plus where covers every single place.
normal.cn: everywhere＝every＋where，每个「where（哪里）」都覆盖。

normal.en: Compare everywhere, somewhere and nowhere as a triangle.
normal.cn: 对比三角：everywhere 全都有、somewhere 某处、nowhere 没有处。

normal.en: Look everywhere for is the phrase for a lost thing.
normal.cn: look everywhere for 到处找，找东西时脱口而出。

normal.en: Everywhere she goes opens a story clause neatly.
normal.cn: Everywhere she goes，从句开头讲故事常用。

normal.en: The sound hints at feeding a seed to each place, for spelling only.
normal.cn: 谐音：「爱夫瑞喂」——每处都喂一颗种子，帮助拼读，不是词源。

abstract.en: Picture dandelion seeds landing one per square of the lawn.
abstract.cn: 画面：蒲公英种子在草坪上每格落一颗。

abstract.en: Sprinkle water over a map until every corner is wet.
abstract.cn: 动作：往地图上洒水直到每个角落都湿。

abstract.en: Hear one song drifting out of every window on the street.
abstract.cn: 听觉：同一段旋律从街上每扇窗飘出。

examples.en: We looked everywhere for my lost key.
examples.cn: 我们到处找我丢的钥匙。

examples.en: In autumn, red leaves are everywhere in the hills.
examples.cn: 秋天山上到处是红叶。

examples.en: Everywhere he goes, he makes new friends.
examples.cn: 无论他到哪里，都能交到新朋友。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱夫瑞喂」——每处都喂一颗种子，谐音帮助拼读，不是词源。

root: everywhere 由 every 加 where 构成，where 源自古英语 hwaer（处所）。本词与 everyone、everything 同族，分别覆盖人、物、地。

sensesIntro.en: Everywhere sweeps a map: all places around, all places one goes, and all places as one whole.
sensesIntro.cn: everywhere 扫过一张地图：周遭各处、行者所至、以及合为一体的所有地方。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dandelion seeds landing on every square of the lawn.
core.cn: 核心意象：蒲公英种子落在草坪的每一格。

branches.cn: 育婴室里玩具散落各处。
无论她去哪里都写笔记。
名词用法：处处皆美。
所有用法共同的格子地图。
没有一个角落是空的。

intro.en: Everywhere compounds every with where; its cousins cover people, things and amounts.
intro.cn: everywhere 由 every 复合 where；同族词分别覆盖人、物与量。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root applies; the family is Germanic, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 本词与拉丁词根无关，词族属于日耳曼语，因此拉丁同源词列表为空。

items.example: Every supplies the complete sweep.
Where is one of the question words.
The cat is hiding somewhere.
Sit anywhere you like.
The road goes nowhere.
Wherever you go, I will follow.
The kids ran all over the field.
The news spread far and wide.

definition_zh: 精确地；确切地；恰好；正是；完全正确
definition_en: in a precise way; quite so; used to agree strongly
core_image: 天平砝码完美归零：指针停在正中央
scene: 实验室里滴管停在刻度线上，老师点头认可。The recipe calls for exactly two hundred grams of flour.
sceneCN: 这里 exactly 是「精确地」（第 1 个义项：不多不少）；句意是食谱要求精确两百克面粉。

derivatives.zh: 去掉后缀的基础形容词，义为「精确的；确切的」
由 exact 加 -ness 构成，义为「精确；准确」
由 exact 加 -ing 构成，义为「严苛的；要求高的」

senses.title: In a precise way
senses.definition: in a way that is completely correct, with no mistake or difference
senses.definitionCN: 完全正确的方式，毫无差错或偏差
senses.example: Please follow the instructions exactly.
senses.exampleCN: 请严格按说明操作。
senses.why: The Latin root means driven out or measured out, so the image is weighing to the final grain.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「称量完毕、耗尽」，画面是称量到最后一粒。

senses.title: Just so, precisely that
senses.definition: used to emphasize that something is completely right or true
senses.definitionCN: 强调某事完全正确或属实
senses.example: That is exactly what I wanted to say.
senses.exampleCN: 那正是我想说的话。
senses.why: The needle rests in the middle: the statement and the truth balance perfectly.
senses.whyCN: 指针停在正中：陈述与事实完全平衡。

senses.title: An agreement marker
senses.definition: a spoken reply meaning you agree completely
senses.definitionCN: 口语应答，表示完全同意
senses.example: Exactly! That is the whole point of the story.
senses.exampleCN: 完全正确！这正是故事的全部要点。
senses.why: From weighing exactness grows a quick word for a perfect match of minds.
senses.whyCN: 由称量的精确生长出对思想完全契合的快速应答。

intro.en: Exactly comes from exact, from Latin exagere, to weigh out or drive out. The modern word keeps the picture of a perfectly finished measurement.
intro.cn: exactly 由 exact 派生，exact 来自拉丁语 exagere「称量完、耗尽」。现代词保留称量完美的画面。

items.en: Latin exigere meant to drive out, to weigh out, or to complete a measurement.
items.cn: 拉丁语 exigere 意为驱出、称量完毕或完成测量。

items.en: Exactus, its past participle, meant measured out completely, with nothing left over.
items.cn: 过去分词 exactus 意为称量完毕、分毫不差。

items.en: English borrowed exact in the fifteenth century as a rare scholarly word.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入 exact，原为罕见学术词。

items.en: In the scientific age exact became a prized word for precise measurement.
items.cn: 科学时代 exact 成为精确测量的珍贵词汇。

items.en: Exactly grew into agreement talk: exactly so, exactly right.
items.cn: exactly 生长出应答用法：exactly so、exactly right。

note.en: The first group collects the exact family; the second collects near meanings about precision and agreement.
note.cn: 第一组收集 exact 词族；第二组收集与「精确、赞同」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: precise and correct in every detail
entries.definitionCN: 精确的。去掉 -ly 的基础形容词。

entries.definition: making strict demands, hard to satisfy
entries.definitionCN: 严苛的。由 exact 加 -ing 构成，词义已偏移。

entries.definition: to pull out or remove; shares the ex- out-prefix
entries.definitionCN: 提取；拔出。同享 ex-「向外」前缀。

entries.definition: in a precise way, a close synonym
entries.definitionCN: 精确地；正是。最接近的同义词。

entries.definition: completely yes, an agreeing reply
entries.definitionCN: 绝对地；完全正确。应答语。

entries.definition: exactly at a point, as in just six o'clock
entries.definitionCN: 恰好；刚刚。表示时点恰好。

normalIntro.en: Five concrete hooks built from the weighing root and classroom talk.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于称量词根与课堂用语的具体联想。

normal.en: ex- means out and the root means weighed out: nothing is left to chance.
normal.cn: ex-（出）+ 词根（称量完）：分毫不差。

normal.en: Exactly the same is the phrase every comparison needs.
normal.cn: exactly the same 完全一样，比较题常用。

normal.en: Exactly! is the quickest word of strong agreement.
normal.cn: Exactly! 赞同时的口头禅，一句顶十句。

normal.en: Not exactly softens a polite disagreement.
normal.cn: not exactly 不完全是，礼貌否定好帮手。

normal.en: The sound hints at one kick hitting the bullseye, for spelling only.
normal.cn: 谐音：「一脚扎克踢」——一脚踢中靶心，帮助拼读，不是词源。

abstract.en: Picture a balance scale with the needle resting in the center.
abstract.cn: 画面：天平指针停在正中央。

abstract.en: Feel a key sliding into the one lock it was cut for.
abstract.cn: 动作：钥匙滑入唯一配对的锁孔。

abstract.en: Hear two tuning forks singing the same single note.
abstract.cn: 听觉：两支音叉唱出同一个音。

examples.en: Copy the poem exactly as it is written.
examples.cn: 一字不差地抄写这首诗。

examples.en: The train left at exactly half past seven.
examples.cn: 火车恰好在七点半出发。

examples.en: Exactly! You have found the answer.
examples.cn: 完全正确！你找到答案了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一格扎克踢」——一脚踢中靶心，谐音帮助拼读，不是词源。

root: exactly 由 exact（拉丁 exigere「称量完毕」）加 -ly 构成。同根词 exact、exacting、extract 都保留 ex-「向外」与「完成」的核心。

sensesIntro.en: Exactly weighs to the last grain: precise action, perfect match, and a spoken yes.
sensesIntro.cn: exactly 称量到最后一粒：精确行动、完全契合，以及口头的「完全正确」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a balance scale with the needle resting at zero.
core.cn: 核心意象：天平指针停在零点。

branches.cn: 严格按说明操作。
那正是我想说的。
exactly! 口头应答。
称量完毕的共同画面。
相关形容词 exacting 的严苛。

intro.en: Exactly shows the Latin ex- prefix over the exact root; the family is small and precise.
intro.cn: exactly 在 exact 词根上显示拉丁 ex- 前缀；词族小而精确。

latinIntro.en: Latin exigere 'weigh out, drive out' is the shared ancestor of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exigere「称量完、驱出」是这一词族的共同祖先。

items.example: Exact means weighed out fully.
The same root gives act and agent.
items.exampleCN: 同一词根给出 act 与 agent。

items.example: exactly means in an exact way.
Give me the exact time.
An exacting teacher checks every line.
Exactness matters in lab work.
Extract a tooth, extract data.
The doctor examined the patient.

definition_zh: 考试；测验（examination 的缩略形式）
definition_en: a formal test of knowledge, short for examination
core_image: 课桌上倒扣的考卷：铃声一响才能翻开
scene: 监考老师把试卷正面朝下放到每张课桌上。I stayed up late to prepare for the maths exam.
sceneCN: 这里 exam 是「考试」（第 1 个义项：正式的知识测验）；句意是我熬夜备考数学考试。

derivatives.zh: 完整正式形式，义为「考试；检查」
同根动词，义为「检查；测验」
由 examine 加 -er 构成，义为「主考官；检查者」

senses.title: A formal test of knowledge
senses.definition: an official test that shows how much a student has learned
senses.definitionCN: 检验学生学习程度的正式测验
senses.example: The history exam has two parts: writing and speaking.
senses.exampleCN: 历史考试有两部分：笔试和口试。
senses.why: The root examine means to weigh a thing carefully, so an exam weighs what a student knows.
senses.whyCN: 词根 examine 意为仔细称量，考试便是称量学生所知。

senses.title: A close inspection or medical check
senses.definition: a careful look at something or someone, especially a medical one
senses.definitionCN: 对事物或人的仔细查看，尤指医疗检查
senses.example: The doctor gave the patient a quick exam.
senses.exampleCN: 医生给病人做了快速检查。
senses.why: Weighing a patient's health reuses the same careful-measuring picture.
senses.whyCN: 称量病人的健康，复用同一「细量」画面。

intro.en: Exam is the short form of examination, which comes from Latin examinare, to weigh or test. A good exam really is a set of scales for learning.
intro.cn: exam 是 examination 的缩略形式，后者源自拉丁语 examinare「称量、测验」。考试就是学习的秤。

items.en: Latin exigere meant to weigh out or drive out, the base of the whole family.
items.cn: 拉丁语 exigere 意为称量完、驱出，是词族的基础。

items.en: Examinare meant to weigh or test a thing or a person.
items.cn: examinare 意为称量或测验某物某人。

items.en: English borrowed examination in the fourteenth century for careful testing.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 examination，指仔细的检验。

items.en: Schools adopted the word for formal tests of knowledge.
items.cn: 学校将该词用于正式的知识测验。

items.en: The clipped form exam became general speech by the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 缩略形式 exam 到十九世纪成为通用口语。

note.en: The first group collects the examin- family; the second collects near meanings about tests.
note.cn: 第一组收集 examin- 词族；第二组收集与「测验」相关的近义词。

entries.definition: the complete formal word for exam
entries.definitionCN: 考试（完整形式）。正式书面用语。

entries.definition: the person who sets or marks an exam
entries.definitionCN: 主考官。由 examine 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: a sample; shares the ex- out-prefix but a different root
entries.definitionCN: 例子。共享 ex- 前缀，词根不同。

entries.definition: a shorter, often informal check of ability
entries.definitionCN: 测验。较短、较随意的检验。

entries.definition: a quick, small test, often fun
entries.definitionCN: 小测验。快速小型，常带趣味。

entries.definition: an official judgment of ability or progress
entries.definitionCN: 评估。正式的判定与评价。

normalIntro.en: Five concrete hooks built from the weighing root and exam-room life.
normalIntro.cn: 五条基于称量词根与考场生活的具体联想。

normal.en: Exam is the clipped exam-ination: short word for a long paper.
normal.cn: exam 是 examination 的缩写，考卷短了词也短。

normal.en: Take an exam, pass or fail: the verbs pair up neatly.
normal.cn: take an exam 参加考试；pass／fail 一过一挂。

normal.en: ex- means out and the root means weigh: the test weighs your learning.
normal.cn: ex-（出）+ 词根（称量）：把学问称一称。

normal.en: Final exam and midterm exam mark the two ends of a term.
normal.cn: final exam 期末考，midterm exam 期中考，成对出现。

normal.en: The sound hints at touching the book once more before bed, for spelling only.
normal.cn: 谐音：「一个再摸」——考前再摸一遍书，帮助拼读，不是词源。

abstract.en: Picture upside-down papers on desks waiting for the bell.
abstract.cn: 画面：课桌上倒扣的考卷静待铃声。

abstract.en: Feel a hand placing weights on a scale until it balances.
abstract.cn: 动作：往秤上加砝码直到平衡。

abstract.en: Hear the long silence of a room where everyone is thinking.
abstract.cn: 听觉：满室思考的长久安静。

examples.en: Our English exam is next Friday morning.
examples.cn: 我们的英语考试在下周五上午。

examples.en: She passed all her exams with high marks.
examples.cn: 她所有考试都以高分通过。

examples.en: The school nurse gave everyone an eye exam.
examples.cn: 校医给每个人做了视力检查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「一个再摸」——考前再摸一遍书，谐音帮助拼读，不是词源。

root: exam 是 examination 的口语缩略，源自拉丁语 examinare「称量、测验」，词根 exigere 意为「称量完毕」。同根 examine、examiner、examination。

sensesIntro.en: Exam weighs what you know and how healthy you are: two scales, one careful habit of measuring.
sensesIntro.cn: exam 既称量所学，也称量健康：两杆秤，同一种细量的习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: upside-down exam papers waiting for the bell.
core.cn: 核心意象：倒扣在课桌上静待铃声的考卷。

branches.cn: 检验学生所学的正式测验。
医疗与技术检查。
共同的称量画面。
秤给出的判定。
称量发生的安静考场。

intro.en: Exam hides its Latin root in the longer examination; the family is about weighing.
intro.cn: exam 的拉丁词根藏在完整的 examination 之中；词族围绕「称量」。

latinIntro.en: Latin examinare 'to weigh, test' is the shared ancestor of this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 examinare「称量、测验」是这一词族的共同祖先。

items.example: Weighing drives the answer out.
Examine the map before the trip.
Examination names the act of examining.
items.exampleCN: examination 指 examine 的行为。

items.example: The examiner read the rules aloud.
An examinee sits the paper.
Exact shares the weighing idea.

items.meaning: a small part showing the whole
items.example: A quiz samples your knowledge.
items.exampleCN: 小测验抽样检验你的知识。

items.example: A quiz takes ten minutes.
